title: Young student:
html_source: Alec Bannon, a young student who knows Milly.

anchor.prefix:
prinkled it through his fingers ringwise from the chipped eggcup. 

 Then he slit open his letter, glancing down the page and over. Thanks: new tam: Mr Coghlan: lough Owel picnic:
anchor.suffix:
Blazes Boylan's seaside girls. 

 The tea was drawn. He filled his own moustachecup, sham crown Derby, smiling. Silly Milly's birthday gift. Only five she was then. No, wait: four
